results.title: India's manufacturing sector activity growth eases in October on softer rise in output, new orders
results.content: The seasonally adjusted HSBC India Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 54.7 in October from 55.1 in September. Still, it remained above its long-run average and comfortably above the neutral mark of 50.0

results.title: 3 AAP MLAs resign and join BJP; BJP leader Virendra Sachdeva blames Arvind Kejriwal
results.content: In a major political development for Delhi, three sitting Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLAs have resigned from their party and officially joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Delhi BJP President Virendra Sachdeva confirmed the high-profile switch, dealing a severe blow to the AAP leadership.
